skill_mappings.description: Planning, tracking, and allocating money across competing needs, including household or community budgets, expense tracking, and savings goals.
Arranging schedules, coordinating multiple people or tasks, and managing day-to-day logistics so activities run smoothly and on time.
Teaching, tutoring, or coaching others to build a skill, guiding someone through learning, or mentoring a less experienced person.
Resolving disagreements between people, mediating disputes, negotiating terms, or persuading others toward a fair outcome.
Caring for a sick, elderly, or young family member, coordinating medical appointments, or providing hands-on patient/family support.
Planning a community event, gathering, celebration, or fundraiser, including volunteer coordination and outreach to participants.
Planning meals, managing nutrition for a household or group, preparing food at scale, or running informal catering for events.
Leading, supervising, or motivating a group of people toward a shared goal, directing a team's effort, or inspiring others to act.
Gathering information, analyzing data or a situation, evaluating options, and reporting findings or recommendations to others.
Diagnosing and fixing a recurring problem, repairing something broken, troubleshooting an issue, or improving an inefficient process.

Decision Making.description: Ability to make informed decisions under uncertainty.

Strategic Planning.description: Setting long-term goals and defining steps to reach them.

Team Coordination.description: Organizing and aligning efforts of a group.

Team Development.description: Nurturing and growing the skills of others.

Empathy & Crisis Management.description: Managing high-stress situations with emotional intelligence.
